Name: Fallout Outfits
Author: Kalidi
Description:
I saw the amazing mods from the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/gumbo632/mods?gameId=1303]Fallout Valley series by gumbo632[/url] and wanted to change the characters to fit in. Some characters have undergone some drastic changes. I hope you enjoy the mod!

Please feel free to use or add to this mod however you'd like.
